note: Source for skills/skills.json. tools/build_skills.py adds status, file, size and sha256.

skills.name: Chart
skills.description: Makes a bar, line, pie, or scatter chart from your data or from a dropped CSV or XLSX file. Saves a PNG in the IOTA theme.
skills.example: /chart bar of pump runtime by month
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later
Python 3.12 with matplotlib, NumPy, and Pillow (included in the PowerShell edition kit)
EXE edition: a Python runtime with the same libraries, set in Settings or found on PATH

skills.name: Slide deck
skills.description: Builds a 16:9 PowerPoint deck from your request. Layouts include title, bullets, chart, table, and two columns.
skills.example: /deck five slides on our Q3 results
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later
Python 3.12 with python-pptx, matplotlib, and Pillow (included in the PowerShell edition kit)
EXE edition: a Python runtime with the same libraries, set in Settings or found on PATH

skills.name: PDF report
skills.description: Writes a PDF report with headings, text, bullets, tables, and charts. Charcoal pages by default, or white pages for printing.
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later
Python 3.12 with ReportLab, matplotlib, and Pillow (included in the PowerShell edition kit)
EXE edition: a Python runtime with the same libraries, set in Settings or found on PATH

skills.name: Diagram
skills.description: Makes a flowchart or process map and saves it as a PNG.

skills.name: Units and engineering
skills.description: Converts units and works quick engineering formulas. Code does the math, and the answer shows each step and the conversion factor used.
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later, PowerShell edition
Python 3.12 with pint (included in the kit)

skills.name: Finance
skills.description: Finance math: NPV, IRR, XIRR, payback, loan payments, amortization, CAGR, WACC, break-even, and a simple DCF. Tables save as Excel files with live formulas.
skills.example: /fin amortization 25000 at 7% for 5 years with a chart
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later
Python 3.12 with XlsxWriter and matplotlib (included in the PowerShell edition kit)
EXE edition: a Python runtime with the same libraries, set in Settings or found on PATH

skills.name: Table
skills.description: Pulls tables out of a PDF, DOCX, or XLSX file into CSV or XLSX.

skills.name: OCR
skills.description: Reads the text in images, screenshots, and scanned PDFs. Can also save a searchable copy of a PDF or image.
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later, PowerShell edition
Python 3.12 with RapidOCR, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, pypdfium2, pdfplumber, Pillow, and NumPy (included in the kit)
The English PP-OCRv3 OCR model in models\ocr (in the kit, not in this download)

skills.name: Transcribe
skills.description: Writes a transcript with timestamps from an audio or video file. Add "notes" for a summary, decisions, and action items.
requires: IOTA for Windows V1.2 or later, PowerShell edition
Python 3.12 with PyAV (included in the kit)
whisper-cli.exe from the kit
A whisper speech model, base.en or tiny.en, in models\stt (in the kit, not in this download)

skills.name: Summarize
skills.description: Summarizes a dropped PDF, DOCX, TXT, or MD file.

skills.name: Files
skills.description: Works with the files in a folder you choose.
